note: Selectors here are UNVERIFIED. They were authored without network access to the targets, and the weekly freshness workflow (.github/workflows/probe-freshness.yml) is what confirms them. Until `lastVerified` is set, treat a probe result as advisory. A selector that stops matching yields `unavailable` plus a maintenance warning — never a score drop.

probes.name: bot.sannysoft.com headless checks
probes.rationale: The page marks each failing check with a `failed` class. Counting matched elements is more rot-resistant than reading any single row's text.

probes.name: CreepJS trust score
probes.rationale: CreepJS is the highest-value probe because it hunts for tampering specifically — comparing realms and detecting patched toString. Matched against body text rather than a CSS path, since its layout changes far more often than its wording.

probes.name: CreepJS detected lies
probes.rationale: A detected lie means our override was caught in the act, which is categorically worse than an unusual value. Fatal on purpose.
